description.value: Gian's Tandoori Corner is a modern Indian restaurant in Westbank (West Kelowna) carrying on a culinary tradition dating to 1999. Specializing in high-heat clay oven cooking, it serves charred skewers, freshly baked naan, and aromatic curries crafted from time-honored recipes. The restaurant also offers catering for events, food truck bookings, and freshly made Indian sweets daily.
